title: Category:Champions
html:
Champions and Heroes are the largest and most dangerous mobs of their type. They can be recognized by their size and the swirling elements around their feet, as well as noted in the monster infobox. Champions are the lesser ones and normally drop lots of gold, and Heroes usually drop not only gold but yellow and purple items.

This page is dedicated to Champion and Hero monsters you may find in dungeons. Note that usually only unique champions/heroes, champions/heroes that have abilities their normal counterparts do not have, those that are specific quest objectives, or those that are namesakes of dungeon sub-levels will be listed here. Many other "generic" Champions and Heroes will be encountered frequently.
